title: How DXC Technology built a multi-model AI substrate on Amazon Bedrock
summary: DXC Technology runs mission-critical managed IT services for regulated organizations across 70 countries. Learn how DXC built DCX OASIS, its Human+AI operating model, on a governed multi-model substrate in Amazon Bedrock, separating a resilient model substrate from a trusted harn
reason: Customer case study on how DXC built a multi-model substrate on Amazon Bedrock. It announces no new model or capability (group 1), no research artifact (group 2), no financing/M&A/partnership/product launch (group 3), no policy action (group 4), and no open-source tool release (group 5).
